name: eop-fling1600-g0
about: Candidate 1 parity (1a), lead 2026-10-09: is the end-of-page touch jack attached before a fast fling from y~1600 can reach the end? Approach drags to y>=1500, then fast flings (520 px in 150 ms, lift-off ~6500 px/s) until y>=4600 (the g0 hold is at ~5213 on the Simulator), wait for the momentum to settle, then two finger-up drags (520 px, 1200 ms) that carry the page into the hold: it must be held (touchmoves cancelable and prevented, the morph opens) like on g0.0h. Counts only.
